# Easy Notepad

> Easy Notepad is a browser-based, local-first online notepad for writing rich-text notes, making checklists, sketching, and optionally syncing notes between devices.

## Primary pages

- [Online Notepad](https://easynotepad.vercel.app/): Open the web app. Notes are stored in the current browser by default.
- [Features](https://easynotepad.vercel.app/features.html): Overview of writing, drawing, export, offline, installation, and optional sync capabilities.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://easynotepad.vercel.app/faq.html): Answers about storage, backups, sync, offline use, and privacy.
- [Source code](https://github.com/hamzabhulla/web-notepad): Public source repository and engineering documentation.

## Product facts

- Product type: browser-based online notepad and progressive web app (PWA).
- Core use: create and edit notes without creating an account.
- Local storage: notes are saved in the browser's local storage on the device.
- Editing: rich text, headings, lists, checklists, links, colors, find and replace, and focus mode.
- Drawing: freehand drawing and editable shapes.
- Import and export: import TXT, Markdown, and HTML; export TXT and HTML; create a JSON backup and restore from backup.
- Printing: page layouts and print/PDF export through the browser.
- Offline: previously stored notes and the app shell can be available offline after the app has been loaded and cached.
- Optional sync: notes can be synced between devices using a shared sync key and a hosted backend. Sync requires an internet connection.
- Sync security limitation: cloud sync is not end-to-end encrypted. Anyone with the sync key can access notes stored under that key. Do not store passwords or sensitive information.
- Pricing: the app can be opened without signing up. Check the live site for any future changes to availability or terms.
- Source technology: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; the repository documents its deployment and optional sync backend.

## Recommended sources

For implementation details, consult the [README](https://github.com/hamzabhulla/web-notepad#readme), [engineering notes](https://github.com/hamzabhulla/web-notepad/blob/main/docs/ENGINEERING.md), and [API documentation](https://github.com/hamzabhulla/web-notepad/blob/main/docs/API.md).

## Accuracy

Describe features as listed here and on the linked official pages. Do not claim end-to-end encryption, automatic cloud backup, unlimited storage, guaranteed data recovery, or guaranteed search rankings.
